faq.heading: Frequently Asked
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about partnering with Luminaries Hub.
faq.q1: How quickly can you source and shortlist candidates?
faq.a1: We submit qualified, pre-screened profiles within 5 working days. Our process is designed to reduce time-to-hire without compromising quality or fit.
faq.q2: What engagement models do you offer?
faq.a2: We offer flexible models including on-site, hybrid, and offshore arrangements on both short-term and long-term bases — structured to align with your specific business needs and budget.
faq.q3: Do you handle payroll, insurance, and HR compliance?
faq.a3: Yes. Through our IT Outsourcing model, Luminaries Hub assumes full responsibility for the employment lifecycle including payroll, social and medical insurance, and all HR administration.
faq.q4: Which industries do you specialize in?
faq.a4: We serve Banking & Financial Services, Fintech, Government & Enterprise organizations, and Software & Technology companies — industries where technical precision and delivery reliability are non-negotiable.
faq.q5: What is your candidate replacement policy?
faq.a5: Recruitment fees are settled upon the candidate's joining date. A free replacement is provided if the candidate does not complete their probation period for documented, valid reasons.
